lines.en: label halloweenayane1:
scene ayanefreakin1
: What do you {i}mean{/i} you have no idea what’s going on right now?!
lines.zh: : 什么{i}叫{/i}你不知道现在发生了什么？！

lines.en: : Everything was fine and normal a second ago and...and we were at my house! And then there was this girl who showed up and dragged Sensei away and now we’re {i}here!{/i} You remember, right?!?! RIGHT?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 一秒钟前一切都还好好的、很正常，而且……我们还在我家！然后就冒出来一个女孩，把老师拖走了，再然后我们就到{i}这儿{/i}了！你记得的，对吧？！？！对吧？！？！？！

lines.en: : Uhh, Ayane? You maybe want to, like...take a chill-pill for a second? Because I’m not really sure what’s going on, but yelling about it in front of everyone isn’t going to-
lines.zh: : 呃，Ayane？你要不要……先稍微冷静一下？因为我也搞不清状况，但当着所有人的面大喊大叫可解决不了——

lines.en: : Sensei! {i}You{/i} remember, don’t you?! You came with me, right?! You’re still the {i}you{/i} I know, aren’t you?! The one I’m supposed to be with forever?! Please tell me you’re still here! Please!
lines.zh: : 老师！{i}你{/i}记得的，对吧？！你是跟我一起来的，对不对？！你还是我认识的那个{i}你{/i}，对不对？！那个要和我永远在一起的人？！求你了，告诉我你还在这里！求你了！

lines.en: : Ayane, you’re scaring me. Please calm down.
lines.zh: : Ayane，你吓到我了。求你冷静一点。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin2
: {i}Calm down?!{/i} You want me to {i}calm down?!{/i} After being sent back this far?! After everything that happened?! How the fuck am I supposed to calm down, Ami?! How?!
lines.zh: : {i}冷静{/i}？！你要我{i}冷静{/i}？！在被送回这么久之后？！在发生了那么多事之后？！我他妈要怎么冷静，Ami？！怎么冷静？！

lines.en: : Ayane...if you need to go outside and talk, we can. But let the record show that I have no clue what you’re talking about and that I {i}also{/i} think you should stop yelling.
lines.zh: : Ayane……如果你需要到外面去谈，我们可以。但在此声明：我完全听不懂你在说什么，而且我{i}也{/i}觉得你该停止大吼了。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin3
: Did you have a bad dream or something maybe?
lines.zh: : 你是不是做了什么噩梦之类的？

lines.en: : ...bad dream?
: Well...yeah.
lines.zh: : 呃……对啊。

lines.en: : You said all that weird stuff about being “sent back,” but you’ve been right here with us the whole day.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说的那些「被送回来」的怪话，可你明明一整天都跟我们在这儿啊。

lines.en: : You said she’d been practicin’ her set a lot, didn’t you? Think maybe she’s just overworked herself or something like that?
lines.zh: : 你不是说过她最近一直在练她的段子吗？会不会只是把自己练过头了之类的？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be surprised. She’s been trying so hard to make sure her stand-up thing will be perfect lately that {i}I{/i} could probably go up there and perform it.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}一点都不意外。她最近为了让自己的单口表演完美到无可挑剔，拼得我都快能替她上台表演了。

lines.en: : You might have to at this rate. The second floor is still winning and we were really relying on Ayane to come through here.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头，你恐怕还真得上去。二楼现在还领先着呢，我们可全指望 Ayane 在这儿撑场子。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin4
: Heh...
: Ayane...why not just take a seat and-
lines.zh: : Ayane……你不如先坐下来——

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin5
: {b}HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!! SO {i}THIS{/i} IS HOW IT WORKS!??!!??!! OH MY GOD!!! THAT’S EVEN MORE CRUEL THAN I THOUGHT!!!! HAHAHAHAHA!{/B}
lines.zh: : {b}哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！！！！原来是这样运作的吗？？！！？？哦我的天！！！这比我以为的还要残忍！！！！哈哈哈哈哈！{/B}

lines.en: : I...think I’m gonna go see if the cafe lady can make her some tea or something. Chamomile’s supposed to help with nerves, right?
lines.zh: : 我……我去看看咖啡店那位能不能给她弄点茶什么的。洋甘菊不是对缓解紧张有效吗？

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin6

: Yes! Chamomile! Bring me all the fucking chamomile in the world! Because I’m sure fucking going to need it if I’m going to have to sit through both of these two breaking into a million fucking pieces again!
lines.zh: : 对！洋甘菊！把全世界他妈的洋甘菊都给我端来！因为如果我还要坐在这儿看着这两个人再他妈碎成一百万片，我肯定他妈用得上！

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin7
: On it. Nothing to see here, girls! Everybody mind your own business until Ayane calms down, please! Thanks!
lines.zh: : 这就去。这里没什么好看的，姑娘们！在 Ayane 冷静下来之前，大家都忙自己的事吧！谢谢！

lines.en: : You still love me at least, right?
lines.zh: : 至少你还爱着我，对吧？

lines.en: : Ayane, what in the world are you talking about?
lines.zh: : Ayane，你到底在说什么啊？

lines.en: : Things I can’t say in front of everyone else. Things that we do when we’re alone. You still love me, right?
lines.zh: : 一些我不能当着别人面说的事。一些我们独处时会做的事。你还爱着我，对吧？

lines.en: : Because you look different. You smell different. But I know it’s {i}you.{/i} It’s you, right? Where were we just a minute ago? What was I wearing? Where did that girl take you?
lines.zh: : 因为你看上去不一样了。你闻起来也不一样了。但我知道是{i}你{/i}。是你，对吧？一分钟前我们在哪儿？我当时穿的什么？那个女孩把你带到哪儿去了？

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin8
: Please don’t make me start all over...
lines.zh: : 求你了，别让我从头再来一遍……

lines.en: : {i}Please{/i} be you.
lines.zh: : {i}求你{/i}还是你吧。

lines.en: : Molly, move.
lines.zh: : Molly，让开。

lines.en: : Wha- Bronya!? We’re supposed to be in love! You can’t just push past me like-
lines.zh: : 什——Bronya！？我们可是应该在谈恋爱的！你不能就这么从我身边挤过——

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin9
: Ayane...shut the fuck up.
lines.zh: : Ayane……给我他妈闭嘴。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin10
: You. Me. Outside. Now.
lines.zh: : 你。我。出去。现在。

lines.en: : Are you...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: : Who I {i}think{/i} you are?...
lines.zh: : 是我{i}想{/i}的那个人吗？……

lines.en: : That’s a great question. Especially since you’re decidedly {i}not{/i} who I thought you were just a second ago. But that doesn’t change the fact that you’re saying too much.
lines.zh: : 问得好。尤其是你，一秒钟前还完全{i}不是{/i}我以为的那个人。但那改变不了一个事实——你说得太多了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry! I’m just...really scared and...{i}confused{/i} and...everything’s suddenly different, but...it’s the {i}same{/i} and-
lines.zh: : 对不起！我只是……真的很害怕，又……很{i}混乱{/i}，而且……一切都突然不一样了，可……又是{i}一样{/i}的，而且——

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s very, very sad. But I’m going to need you to grow the fuck up for a second and talk to me {i}outside{/i} because it’s dangerous for you to keep throwing your little temper tantrum in here.
lines.zh: : 是啊。真是非常、非常惨。但我需要你他妈成熟一点，{i}出去{/i}跟我谈，因为你继续在这儿耍小孩子脾气是很危险的。

lines.en: : Temper...tantrum?
lines.zh: : 小孩子……脾气？

lines.en: : Outside. {i}Now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 出去。{i}现在{/i}。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin11
: What the hell was that about?
lines.zh: : 那到底是怎么一回事？

lines.en: : I have no idea. I’ve never seen Ayane get that...{i}crazy{/i} before.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。我从没见过 Ayane 这么……{i}疯{/i}过。

lines.en: : You don’t think what Miss Imai said was true about the whole...overworking thing, do you? Because Ayane always works hard. Just...{i}this...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你不觉得 Imai 小姐说的「过度劳累」是真的吗？因为 Ayane 一直都很拼命。只是……{i}这次{/i}……

lines.en: : Yeah...I hope everything’s okay. Are you sure you don’t want to go out there with them, though?
lines.zh: : 是啊……希望一切都好。不过你确定不想跟她们一起出去吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Maya scares me when she gets all serious like that.
lines.zh: : 不太想。Maya 一认真起来那样子，我害怕。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin12
: {i}Besides, I doubt I’d have any idea what the two of them are talking about anyway...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再说了，我也搞不懂她们俩在谈什么……{/i}

lines.en: : Okay, so...To start, mind explaining to me what the fuck is going on here?
lines.zh: : 好了，那么……首先，能不能给我解释一下这里他妈的到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Is it...really {i}you,{/i} Maya?...
lines.zh: : 真的是{i}你{/i}吗，Maya？……

lines.en: : What kind of question is that? Who else would I be?
lines.zh: : 这叫什么话？我还能是谁？

lines.en: : Well...still {i}you,{/i} but...like...a different version? One that’s...way more upfront about her feelings for Sensei and-
lines.zh: : 嗯……还是{i}你{/i}，但是……像是……另一个版本？一个……对自己的感情坦率得多的版本，而且——

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin13
: H...How do you even know about that?! I’ve barely said a word to or {i}about{/i} him in years! And especially not to you!
lines.zh: : 你、你怎么会知道那件事？！我这些年几乎没跟他说过一句话，也没{i}提过{/i}他！尤其是没跟你说过！

lines.en: : But in {i}my{/i} world you did!
lines.zh: : 可在{i}我的{/i}世界里，你说过！

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin14
: In {i}my{/i} world, you two...
lines.zh: : 在{i}我的{/i}世界里，你们俩……

lines.en: : Well, it pains me to admit it, but you two were in love. You were still a bitch about it, of course. But I knew how you felt and you knew that {i}I{/i} knew that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，虽然承认这个让我很痛心，但你们俩是相爱的。当然，你对这件事的态度还是那么讨人厌。但{i}我{/i}知道你的感受，而你也知道我知道。

lines.en: : I doubt what you witnessed was “love.” I was probably just going through another lustful rage. That happens sometimes. But...wait, how the fuck are {i}you{/i} involved now? Do you know about the resets?
lines.zh: : 我怀疑你看到的算不上「爱」。我大概只是又陷入了一阵欲望的狂热而已。这种事时常发生。不过……等等，你他妈怎么也掺和进{i}来{/i}了？你知道重置的事？

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin15
: Yeah...Do you think that’s what’s...happening right now?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你觉得现在发生的……就是这个吗？

lines.en: : Also, can I hug you? Because it’s been a long time since I’ve seen the {i}real{/i} you and...I miss you a lot.
lines.zh: : 还有，我能抱你一下吗？因为我已经很久没见过{i}真正{/i}的你了，而且……我很想你。

lines.en: : Maybe later. I’m just...I need a minute to try and wrap my head around everything right now.
lines.zh: : 以后再说吧。我只是……我需要一点时间，把这一切理清楚。

lines.en: : You and me both. One second, I’m at {i}one{/i} party. The next, I’m at a party several years before that and no one remembers where we were just a second ago. Unless {i}you-{/i}
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。前一秒我还在{i}某个{/i}派对上。下一秒我就在几年之前的另一个派对上，而没有一个人记得我们刚才在哪里。除非{i}你{/i}——

lines.en: : No...I’ve been here the whole time. My last reset was months ago. But nobody else is supposed to know about them here.
lines.zh: : 不……我一直都在这里。我上一次重置是几个月前。但这里按理说不该有别人知道这些事。

lines.en: : Not even Sensei?
lines.zh: : 连老师也不知道？

lines.en: : {i}Definitely{/i} not Sensei. He’s too busy fucking Ami to figure any of that stuff out. And I doubt he’ll-
lines.zh: : 老师{i}绝对{/i}不行。他光顾着干 Ami 了，哪有空去弄明白这些。而且我怀疑他——

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin16
: Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: : Was that you...implying he actually figures it out in your timeline? Or...is that just wishful thinking on my end?
lines.zh: : 你刚才那话……是在暗示在你的时间线里他真的弄清楚了？还是……只是我自己在痴心妄想？

lines.en: : Where or...{i}when{/i} I come from, he knows. Makoto too. And then...Yumi sometimes and...Tsuneyo sometimes and...I {i}thought{/i} Sana did, but...
lines.zh: : 在我来的那个地方、{i}那个时间{/i}里，他是知道的。Makoto 也知道。然后……Yumi 有时候知道，还有……Tsuneyo 有时候，而且……我原本{i}以为{/i} Sana 也知道，但是……

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin17
: And you said I...loved him?
lines.zh: : 你还说……我爱他？

lines.en: : Yeah...and I can promise you it wasn’t just a “lustful rampage” like you suggested.
lines.zh: : 嗯……而且我可以向你保证，那绝不是你所说的什么「欲望狂潮」。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin18
: Is it nice there?...
lines.zh: : 那边……好吗？……

lines.en: : As nice as it...{i}can{/i} be when you’re caught in a timeloop, I guess.
lines.zh: : 在你被困在循环里的时候，大概……{i}能{/i}有多好就有多好吧。

lines.en: : So...he and I are...
lines.zh: : 所以……他和我……

lines.en: : We’re {i}together{/i} there?...
lines.zh: : 在那边我们是{i}在一起{/i}的？……

lines.en: : Why are you hesitating? What happened? What did he do? What did {i}I{/i} do? Why aren’t your eyes filled with joy and envy describing this to me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么犹豫？发生了什么？他做了什么？{i}我{/i}做了什么？为什么你说起这些的时候，眼里没有喜悦和嫉妒？

lines.en: : Maya, I don’t know how you’re going to react to this, so I’m just going to come out and say it...
lines.zh: : Maya，我不知道你会怎么反应，所以我就直说了……

lines.en: : You get sent back during a reset. And the {i}you{/i} who takes your place is just as oblivious to all of this as everyone here.
lines.zh: : 你在一次重置中被送回去了。而取代{i}你{/i}的那个你，和这里的其他人一样，对这一切一无所知。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin19
: Wait, {i}I{/i} get sent back?! How?! That’s not how it’s supposed to work! What the fuck happened?!
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}我{/i}被送回去了？！怎么会？！按理说不该是这样的！到底他妈发生了什么？！

lines.en: : I, uhh...
: I’m pretty sure you guys had sex on the roof.
lines.zh: : 我大概能确定，你们俩是在天台上做的。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin20
: You’re joking, right?
lines.zh: : 你是在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I didn’t {i}see{/i} what happened...just the...the aftermath...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我没{i}看到{/i}经过……只看到了……事后……

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin21
: {b}{size=+20}FUCKING HELL! SERIOUSLY, ME?!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+20}操他妈的！认真的吗，就我？！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin22
: Am I that bad at controlling myself even a gajillion years into the future where I’d risk everything to just fuck him one more time?! Does this lust know no bounds?!
lines.zh: : 就算到了无数年后的未来，我难道还是控制不住自己，会为了再和他做一次而赌上一切吗？！这股欲望到底有没有尽头？！

lines.en: : Uhh...I...I don’t know?
lines.zh: : 呃……我……我不知道？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many Senseis I’ve broken, Ayane? Because it’s a fucking lot! So if {i}I’m{/i} actually the one who broke this time, I probably deserve it! But still!
lines.zh: : 你知道我弄坏了多少个 Sensei 吗，Ayane？因为那他妈的可多了！所以如果这次真的是{i}我{/i}把事情搞砸的，那我大概罪有应得！但就算是这样！

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin23
: Aren’t there...more pressing matters to talk about than your sexual relationship with Sensei?
lines.zh: : 比起你和老师的性关系，不是还有更紧迫的事要谈吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, we’ll get to those. For now, I want to hear more about what happened in {i}your{/i} world. Because I can’t even remember the last time there was any sort of new development {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，那些待会儿再说。现在我想多听听{i}你的{/i}世界发生了什么。因为我连{i}这里{/i}上一次有什么新进展是什么时候都记不清了。

lines.en: : What happened to {i}him{/i} when I vanished? Did he blame himself? He probably did, didn’t he?
lines.zh: : 我消失之后{i}他{/i}怎么样了？他怪自己了吗？他大概怪了吧？

lines.en: : He kind of, just...shut himself off from everyone but Ami for a few months. He still hasn’t fully recovered really. It’s been...probably a year since then.
lines.zh: : 他差不多……就是把自己封闭起来，除了 Ami 谁都不见，有好几个月。他其实到现在都还没完全恢复。从那以后……大概过了一年。

lines.en: : Ugh! I can’t believe I fucking did that! Guess it just goes to show no matter {i}how{/i} many times I tell myself I’ll be able to keep my distance when he comes back, I’ll still fucking crumble in the end!
lines.zh: : 啊！我真不敢相信我他妈居然干出这种事！看来这正说明，不管我告诉自己{i}多少{/i}次、等他回来时我一定能保持距离，到最后我还是会他妈崩溃！

lines.en: : But this is huge, Ayane. This means it’s {i}possible.{/i} This means there’s a method to all of this madness and that through enough trial and error, things can actually start to work!
lines.zh: : 但这可是件大事，Ayane。这说明这是{i}有可能{/i}的。说明这一切疯狂背后是有方法的，说明只要经过足够多的试错，事情是真的能开始好转的！

lines.en: : Of course, it will probably be millions of years until it actually does considering my luck, but {i}still!{/i} I can find him!
lines.zh: : 当然，考虑到我的运气，大概要等上几百万年才会真的好转，但{i}就算这样{/i}！我能找到他！

lines.en: : What? Why do you look so sad?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你为什么看起来这么难过？

lines.en: : Because I don’t want to wait millions of years...I want him {i}now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为我不想等几百万年……我{i}现在{/i}就想要他。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin24
: Yeah, well get in line. You’ve been without him for like ten minutes while I’ve legitimately lost track of the last time there was even someone I could delude myself into believing is him here.
lines.zh: : 是吗，那排队去吧。你才离开他十分钟，而我早就记不清上一次这里出现一个能让我自欺欺人地当成是他的人是什么时候了。

lines.en: : That doesn’t make it any less scary for me, Maya! And also, I don’t understand what that means! Aren’t they {i}all{/i} Sensei? Just at...different points in time or something? Like, isn’t that what being “reset” means?
lines.zh: : 那也不会让我好过一点啊，Maya！而且我不懂那是什么意思！他们不{i}都{/i}是 Sensei 吗？只是在……不同的时间点之类的？「重置」不就是这个意思吗？

lines.en: : Maybe for you and me and everyone else with a vagina. He’s the exception to that. All {i}this{/i} one does is fuck Ami and watch football.
lines.zh: : 对你、对我、对所有有阴道的人来说也许是。他是个例外。{i}这{/i}一个除了干 Ami 就是看橄榄球。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin25
: {i}What?{/i}
: I mean, they all fuck Ami. The football thing is, like...seriously annoying though. I have no idea how this one made it so far. Just bring on the next one already.
lines.zh: : 我是说，他们都会干 Ami。但看橄榄球这事……真的超烦。我真不知道这一个是怎么活到现在的。赶紧换下一个吧。

lines.en: : Maya...I really miss you.
lines.zh: : Maya……我真的很想你。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin26
: I mean...I wish I could say the same, but...you’re just Ayane to me.
lines.zh: : 我倒是……希望我也能这么说，不过……你对我来说只是 Ayane 而已。

lines.en: : Do we have a...better relationship where you’re from? Do I become less mean once I finally find what I’m looking for? Also, {i}Yumi?{/i} Really? How does {i}she{/i} become involved?
lines.zh: : 在你那边我们关系更好吗？等我终于找到自己想要的东西之后，我是不是就没那么刻薄了？还有，{i}Yumi{/i}？真的吗？{i}她{/i}是怎么掺和进来的？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure which of those questions to answer first, so I’ll just say that our relationship is still mostly one-sided. I doubt you...cared much about me there either.
lines.zh: : 我真不确定该先回答哪个问题，所以我就说一句吧——我们的关系基本上还是单方面的。我怀疑……你在那边也不怎么在乎我。

lines.en: : But I’d have never learned about this world if it wasn’t for you, so...I owe you a lot of thanks. And I never got to really say that before you disappeared.
lines.zh: : 但如果没有你，我永远不会知道这个世界的存在，所以……我欠你很多谢谢。而在你消失之前，我一直没能好好说出口。

lines.en: : Don’t thank me for unintentionally dragging you into an eternity worth of misery and regretful encounters with people who resemble the man you love. If I really did that, I ruined your life.
lines.zh: : 别谢我，谢我无意中把你拖进了无尽的痛苦，还有无数次与那个和你爱的男人相像的人之间令人悔恨的相遇。如果我真的做了那种事，那我毁了你的人生。

lines.en: : It’s not like you went out of your way to get me involved. It was kind of the opposite, actually. Like you never wanted me to be involved to begin with.
lines.zh: : 你又不是特意要把我卷进来的。其实恰恰相反。就像你从头到尾都不想让我卷进来一样。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. Why would I want to drag anyone else into this mess? It sucks. The best case scenario is you being repeatedly sent back every few semesters so you don’t have to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对啊。我为什么要把别人拖进这摊烂事里？这破事糟透了。最好的情况也不过是每隔几个学期你就被送回去一次，好让你不必面对这些。

lines.en: : Like sure, you might have to deal with Sensei fucking Ami and binging football for a few months sometimes. But eventually, there’s going to be one who likes blondes and you’ll get to be happy again for a little while.
lines.zh: : 比如，没错，有时候你可能得忍受几个月，看着 Sensei 干 Ami、刷橄榄球。但最终总会出现一个喜欢金发的人，然后你又能开心一阵子。

lines.en: : That’s not {i}true{/i} happiness, though.
lines.zh: : 那不是{i}真正{/i}的幸福。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin27
: But you’ll {i}feel{/i} like it is because you’ll be none the wiser to what’s actually going on behind the scenes. Trust me, I’m right.
lines.zh: : 可你会{i}觉得{/i}那就是，因为你根本不知道幕后到底发生了什么。相信我，我是对的。

lines.en: : Well, even if you are...I don’t regret learning. I don’t regret falling even harder for him than I already had before all of this started.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就算你是对的……我也不后悔知道。我不后悔比这一切开始之前更深地爱上了他。

lines.en: : Sorry, should I take this as an admission that you’re {i}also{/i} fucking my boyfriend in the future where he and I get back together?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我是不是该把这当成一种承认——在我和他复合的那个未来里，你{i}也{/i}在干我男朋友？

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin28
: He’s fucking everyone, isn’t he?
lines.zh: : 他谁都干，是吧？

lines.en: : You said it, not me.
lines.zh: : 这话是你说的，不是我。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin29
: This rage will fuel me for millennia.
lines.zh: : 这股怒火够我烧上几千年。

lines.en: : O-On the bright side! He’d definitely pick you over everyone else if he really had to!
lines.zh: : 那、那往好处想！如果他真的非选不可的话，他肯定会选你的！

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin30

: Well, duh. That’s how being star-crossed lovers works. I just never realized other stars would start getting dragged into our tragic love story and turn this into some sort of everlasting meteor shower.
lines.zh: : 废话。命途多舛的恋人不就是这么回事。我只是没料到，别的星星也会被拽进我们这段悲剧恋情里，把它变成某种永不休止的流星雨。

lines.en: : So do you, like...want to try and figure out how to go back {i}together{/i} then?
lines.zh: : 那你想……试着{i}一起{/i}找出回去的办法吗？

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin31
: Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : We {i}can,{/i} right? Like...this is probably just another one of those weird...reset puzzle things! And we just have to solve it and we’ll go right back to the hyper-depressive harem comedy where we belong!
lines.zh: : 我们{i}可以{/i}的，对吧？就像……这大概只是又一个那种诡异的……重置谜题！我们只要解开它，就能回到我们该在的那个——极度抑郁的后宫喜剧里去了！

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin32
: D-Don’t look at me like that! This is only temporary! I’m...I’m here for a reason! I have to be! So I’ll just...stay positive and-
lines.zh: : 别、别用那种眼神看我！这只是暂时的！我……我是有原因才在这里的！肯定是！所以我会……保持乐观，然后——

lines.en: : Just stop, okay?
lines.zh: : 别说了，好吗？

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin33
: Getting your hopes up is...the worst thing you can do here.
lines.zh: : 抱有希望……是你在这里能做的最糟的事。

lines.en: : Just take solace in the fact that you have someone who won’t look at you like you’re insane whenever you talk about the world ending.
lines.zh: : 你就知足吧——至少有个人，在你谈起世界末日的时候，不会像看疯子一样看你。

lines.en: : Plus, I doubt the “me” who took my place would be happy to be swapped out for a more jaded, narcissistic version.
lines.zh: : 再说，取代我的那个「我」，恐怕也不会乐意被换成一个更愤世嫉俗、更自恋的版本。

lines.en: : But she’ll become that way on her own...won’t she? Just like you did.
lines.zh: : 但她自己也会变成那样的……不是吗？就像你一样。

lines.en: : Then let her.
lines.zh: : 那就让她变。

lines.en: : Maya...you don’t mean that.
lines.zh: : Maya……你不是那个意思。

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin34

: Oh, I know. I would {i}gladly{/i} screw myself over if it meant getting out of this loop. I just felt like I was supposed to say something like that there or it might negatively affect my future in some way.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道。如果能让这个循环结束，我{i}乐意{/i}把自己坑惨。我只是觉得在那儿我该说点那种话，否则可能会以某种方式对我的未来造成负面影响。

lines.en: : Oh.
: We’re still fucked, though. I have no idea when the next reset is coming. And if {i}that{/i} was the catalyst that sent you here, I imagine it’ll have to be another that takes you back.
lines.zh: : 不过我们还是完蛋了。我不知道下一次重置什么时候来。而如果{i}那{/i}是把你送到这儿来的契机，我想大概也得再来一次，才能把你送回去。

lines.en: : So am I just...supposed to wait here until that happens? Isn’t there something we can do?...
lines.zh: : 所以我就……只能在这里干等到那时候？我们就没有能做的事吗？……

lines.en: scene ayanefreakin35
: I don’t know. Do you like football?
lines.zh: : 不知道。你喜欢橄榄球吗？
